clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, Hyacinth Mushrooms grow at the roots of trees across Teldrassil. Night elf herbalists use them for medicine, and grell and grellkin forage for them.

Hyacinth Mushrooms grow in Shadowglen among the trees and roots of Aldrassil. Forest healers use them in remedies for young night elf sentinels and trainees harmed by venomous creatures. The spiders of Shadowthread Cave are among the dangers they face, and the mushrooms go into soothing draughts and antivenoms. Corrupted grell also hoard them.
